stories.title: The Silence of the Lambs stage play comes to Storyhouse in Chester
stories.summary: The world stage premiere of The Silence of the Lambs is coming to Storyhouse in Chester for a week in February, with John Partridge playing Hannibal Lecter. stories.title: Queensferry recruitment firm shortlisted in four categories at UK Small Business Awards
stories.summary: Enbarr Enterprises and its director Vicki Roskams are finalists at the awards, which take place in Birmingham on 19 December.

stories.title: Community food shop selling 10 items for £3 opens at Ysgol Bryn Coch in Mold
stories.summary: The Big Bocs Bwyd at the Mold primary school is open to everyone on Tuesday mornings and Wednesday afternoons, with no referral needed.

stories.title: Who decided Flintshire taxpayers should pay £8.25m for Catholic schools? Councillor wants answers
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has been asked who decided it should pay £8.25m towards modernising Catholic schools in the county, and when. Cllr Andrew Parkhurst (Cilcain, Liberal Democrats) raised the question at the council’s Corporate Resources Overview and Scrutiny Committee on Thursday.
